subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should agent-originated `message(action=send)` deliveries receive selected provider/model/full-model/thinking context for `messages.responsePrefix` templates, or should message-tool sends remain static/identity-only?
rationale: Current main deliberately skips unresolved dynamic prefixes because the send path does not perform model selection; completing the request requires choosing a runtime contract and ownership boundary.

options.title: Thread Run Context Into Sends
options.body: Use the actual selected run context for agent-originated message-tool sends and keep unresolved-template skipping for sends without run context.

options.title: Document Static/Identity Only
options.body: Keep current behavior and document that message-tool sends support only static and identity prefixes until a future run-context design exists.

options.title: Split A Narrow Design Tracker
options.body: Open a narrower design issue for selected-model prefix parity before closing this broader prefix-consistency report.

recommendation.title: Thread Run Context Into Sends
recommendation.body: Use the actual selected run context for agent-originated message-tool sends and keep unresolved-template skipping for sends without run context.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-history route for the current send-path implementation and merged the partial fix that left this product boundary open.
